reason: I already take a multi-form magnesium and I'm not sure why I'd switch to a single form. The lab report is a good sign, but 200 mg for $30 a month isn't giving me anything I can't get already.
objection: Why one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? And I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so 30 sachets would probably sit there.
would_change_my_mind: A named independent lab with a report I can open and check before buying, plus a lower price per day than the multi-form blends I already see.
